subject: Banking
title: Foreign Exchange Trading
description: Learn Foreign Exchange Trading in one minute.

hook.text: The forex market trades $7.5 trillion daily. Banks handle most of it and profit from every currency conversion.

buildup.text: Corporations need to convert currencies for international trade. Banks charge a spread on every conversion.

discovery.text: Five banks control 50% of global forex trading. Citibank, JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank, UBS.

twist.text: In 2013, banks were caught rigging forex rates. Traders coordinated in chat rooms called 'The Cartel' and 'The Mafia.'

climax.text: Forex is hugely profitable because every international transaction needs a currency conversion.

punchline.text: $7.5 trillion daily. Five banks control half of all currency trades.

quiz.question: How much is traded daily in the global forex market?
